# Smith-Midland to Release Third Quarter 2026 Earnings on Monday, November 16


*November 16, 2026* |[Investor Relations / Financials](https://smithmidland.com/blog/category/investor-relations/) ,[Smith-Midland Corporation](https://smithmidland.com/blog/category/smith-midland-corporation/)


***Company to Present and Host 1×1 Investor Meetings at the 18th Annual Southwest IDEAS Investor Conference on November 19th***


**MIDLAND, VA /[ACCESS Newswire](https://www.accessnewswire.com/) / November 12, 2026 /** Smith-Midland Corporation (NASDAQ:SMID), a provider of innovative, high-quality proprietary and patented precast concrete products and systems, today announced the company will issue a press release and file its Form 10-Q for its third quarter 2026 earnings on Monday, November 16, 2026.


The company will also present at the Southwest IDEAS Investor Conference on Thursday, November 19, 2026 in Dallas, TX, led by Ashley Smith, Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, and Dominic Hunter, Chief Financial Officer. The company’s presentation is scheduled to begin at 1:20pm CT and a webcast can be accessed through the conference host’s main website:[https://www.threepartadvisors.com/southwest](https://pr.report/ti5f) . Qualified investors interested in participating or learning more about the IDEAS conferences, please contact Lacey Wesley at (817) 769 -2373 orlWesley@IDEASconferences.com .


**About Smith-Midland Corporation**


[Smith-Midland](https://pr.report/ti5g) develops, manufactures, licenses, rents, and sells a broad array of precast concrete products and systems for use primarily in the construction, transportation, and utility industries.


Smith-Midland Corporation has three manufacturing facilities in: Midland, VA, Reidsville, NC, and Columbia, SC, and a J-J Hooks® Safety Barrier rental firm,[Concrete Safety Systems](https://pr.report/ti5h) . Easi-Set Worldwide, a wholly owned subsidiary of Smith-Midland Corporation, licenses the production and sale of Easi-Set products, including J-J Hooks and SlenderWall®, and provides diversification opportunities to the precast industry worldwide. For more information, please call (540) 439-3266 or visit[www.smithmidland.com](https://pr.report/ti5i) .
